items.source: Implementations perform the actual work of getting the actual values. They must implement the callback method getTypeValue which can throw SQLExceptions that will be caught and translated by the calling code. This callback method has access to the underlying Connection via the given CallableStatement object, if that should be needed to create any database-specific objects.
items.translation: 实现负责获取实际值的具体工作。它们必须实现回调方法 getTypeValue，该方法可以抛出 SQLException，这些异常将被调用代码捕获并转换。如果需要通过给定的 CallableStatement 对象访问底层 Connection 以创建任何数据库特定对象，则该回调方法可以通过该对象访问 Connection。

items.source: Get the type value from the specific object.
items.translation: 从特定对象获取类型值。

items.source:
Constant that indicates an unknown (or unspecified) SQL type.
Passed into setTypeValue if the original operation method does
not specify an SQL type.
items.translation: 指示未知（或未指定）SQL 类型的常量。如果原始操作方法未指定 SQL 类型，则将其传递给 `setTypeValue`。

items.source: SQLException - if an SQLException is encountered setting parameter values (that is, there's no need to catch SQLException)
items.translation: SQLException - 如果在设置参数值时遇到 SQLException（即无需捕获 SQLException）。

items.source: Constant that indicates an unknown (or unspecified) SQL type.
items.translation: 指示未知（或未指定）SQL 类型的常量。

items.source: paramIndex - the index of the parameter for which we need to set the value
items.translation: paramIndex - 需要设置其值的参数的索引

items.source: sqlType - the SQL type of the parameter we are setting
items.translation: sqlType - 我们要设置的参数的 SQL 类型

items.source: typeName - the type name of the parameter (optional)
